claims.reasoning: Hall's knee is no good and Achane's not walking through that door either, so I need a body getting touches, not a name sitting pretty. Kid in Jersey green's been getting the rock while the starter's banged up, that's a job opening and I don't leave jobs unfilled. Ferguson's the third tight end on a bench that only needs two, he goes.

note_reply: Nobody threatens my family and lives to read about it, you understand me, so let's not do this again. I didn't sit on my hands — went and got a body for the backfield today because Hall's hurt and Achane ain't walking through that door, that's a problem you fix at the market, not with a speech. Record's an embarrassment, I know it better than anybody typing about it, but I don't bench my people over a bad month and I don't panic either. We're gonna eat this week, one way or another.
